classifier: train-only top2000 intercentroid-variance genes; logCP10K reference scope; standardized cosine centroid
source_holdout: exclude one melanoma source from ALL label training; test its heldout melanoma cells
limitations: inherited labels; same-unit train/test possible in ordinary split; no patient-independent validation; no simulated mixed-spot accuracy or proof of spatial deconvolution accuracy
